  • Method Details

    • newSMInputFactory

      public static org.codehaus.staxmate.SMInputFactory newSMInputFactory()
      Create a StaxMate input factory using a StAX implementation which is secured against XXE by Apache Commons Secure XML, coalesces characters and does not support DTDs.

      The StAX implementation must natively implement Stax2, such as Woodstox. For other implementations (such as the JDK default) StaxMate wraps the reader in a Stax2ReaderAdapter which does not track the element depth for XMLStreamReader.nextTag(). The GeoTools XmlStreamGeometryReader uses that method, so after reading some geometries (such as curves) StaxMate cursors silently skip the elements after it.

      The GeoTools geometry reader reads from SMInputCursor.getStreamReader() directly, bypassing the cursors. StaxMate allows this but discourages it, because advancing the reader directly can desync the cursors (see StaxMate issue #2). As of StaxMate 2.4.2 this works because cursors resync using getDepth() of the reader, which is only correct for all methods with a native Stax2 implementation, and because the geometry is read within the element of a child cursor which is not used afterward.

      If a future StaxMate version resolves issue #2 (for instance by wrapping the returned reader to keep the cursors synchronized), this check may no longer be needed. Note that StaxMate may be upgraded by automatic dependency updates without anyone checking whether that issue has been resolved, so keep the check unless it has been verified to be unnecessary.

      Returns:
      the StaxMate input factory
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the StAX implementation does not natively implement Stax2
